name: Garden design
desc: A succession of flowering worked out for your ground, your light, and your winter — alpine miniatures through to background giants.

name: Installation
desc: Field-grown or potted stock, planted by the people who raised it. Cottage-style or formal, whichever argument you found more persuasive.

name: Maintenance
desc: Ongoing care through the season, so the border in year three looks like the drawing from year one.

name: Site clearing
desc: Brambles, weed trees, and old foundations. Kate has coaxed gardens out of worse — ask about the barn foundation full of broken glass.

name: Stone work
desc: Walls, steps and edges built to sit right in a Vermont landscape and survive the frost heave.

name: Trees & shrubs
desc: Planting, pruning, and removals — including the specimens that are not supposed to do well up here.

name: Pond work
desc: Water in the landscape, and the moisture-lovers that belong at its edge.

name: And more
desc: If it belongs in a Northeast Kingdom garden, it is worth a telephone call.
